title: Derivation and culturing of neural stem cells from human embryonic brain tissue
protocol: Add 200 μL Liberase Blendzyme to 15 mL of warmed PBS.
Wash embryonic brain tissue with phosphate buffered saline (PBS) to remove excess blood.
Disaggregate tissue into a slurry consistency using scissors or a razor blade, ensuring sufficient solution volume.
Transfer fragmented slurry into the pre-warmed PBS prepared in step 1.
Place the sample in a pre-warmed shaking incubator for 15 min.
Filter the sample into a new sterile 50 mL conical tube through a 70μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge the NSCs for 5 min at 290g at room temperature.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 4–12 mL of RBC lysis buffer.
Incubate the cells for 5 min at room temperature.
Add an equal volume of PBS and centrifuge the sample for 5 min at 290 g.
If the pellet is still red, repeat steps 8-10.
Remove the supernatant and wash the cells with 5 mL of sterile PBS.
Centrifuge the sample for 5 min at 290 g.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 10 mL NCC supplemented with Mycozap.
Transfer to a 10 cm ultra-low plate (or 60mm plate if the pellet is smaller).
Culture hNSCs in Mycozap media for 2 weeks prior to use for experiments.
Aliquot Mycozap and store at -20°C, thawing prior to each use.
Monitor the color of the media; if it turns orange or yellow within the first week, add fresh media.
Minimize media changes during initial stages when cell density is low.
Supplement media based on changes in acidity as cell density increases.
Cryopreserve NSCs after 1-2 weeks in culture.
Expand NSCs on polyornithine-laminin PoL plates for downstream applications.
Save multiple copies of early passage hNSCs (P1-P6) for long-term use.
Pre-warm media in the 37°C water bath.
Collect hNSCs in suspension into 50 mL conical tube.
Rinse plate an additional 1–2 times with PBS collecting the additional rinses.
Centrifuge the sample for 5 min at 290 g at room temperature.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of warm NCC media.
Assess cell viability using a dye exclusion test such as Trypan Blue solution.
Transfer desired number of cells to cryovial(s) and supplement with 100 μL of DMSO ensuring that the final volume is 1 mL of 10% DMSO in NCC per vial.
Transfer vials to a freezing container and move the container into a -80°C freezer.
Transfer vials to liquid nitrogen after 24 h for long term storage.
Dilute 0.01% poly-L-ornithine solution 1:5 in PBS without calcium and magnesium.
Coat entire surface of cell culture plate with diluted poly-L-ornithine solution.
Incubate coated plates for 1–3 hours at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Rinse plate gently with PBS.
Dilute laminin stock to a final concentration of 5 μg/mL in PBS.
Coat entire surface of cell culture plate with diluted laminin solution.
Incubate coated plates overnight (16–24 hours) at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Pre-warm media in 37°C water bath.
Retrieve hNSCs vial from liquid nitrogen and immediately transfer to a 37°C water bath.
Acclimate thawed cells with warm media in a drop-wise manner.
Transfer cells to a 15 mL conical tube after thawing.
Centrifuge the cells for 5 minutes at 290 g at room temperature.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells in 1 mL of warm media.
Pipette up and down gently 3–4 times to mix cells with media.
Assess cell viability using Trypan Blue on clean countess slides.
Plate hNSCs on PoL coated plates at approximately 5 × 10^4 cells per cm² (3 × 10^6 cells on a 100 mm dish) with appropriate media volume (approximately 8 mL total volume for a 100 mm dish).
Ensure even coating of cells across the plate.
Incubate the plate at 37°C, 5% CO2 to allow cells to adhere for 24 hours.
Replace half the media with warm fresh media the next day.
Increase the total volume of media in the culture plate as cells propagate, ensuring daily media changes and avoiding full replacement of media at once unless passaging.
Passage cells when they reach greater than 85% confluency.
Remove media from the plate for passaging.
Rinse the plate gently with PBS rocking back and forth 2–3 times.
Add TrypLE until it covers the entirety of the plate (approximately 1 mL for a 100 mm dish, 0.5 mL for a 6 well dish).
Incubate the plate for 2–5 minutes at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Once cell detachment is complete, add 1–2 mL of PBS to collect cells gently pipetting up and down to break up clumps and collect into a 15 mL conical tube.
Rinse the plate an additional 1–2 times with PBS collecting the additional rinses.
Centrifuge the cells for 5 minutes at 290 g at room temperature.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of warm media.
Assess the cell viability with Trypan Blue on clean countess slides.
Plate cells according to plating and upkeep instructions in steps 36–40.
Note: Plate hNSCs onto tissue culture plates 24–48 hours prior to functional/stem cell assays to form neural spheres as suspension culture.
